name: gemkeeper
description: Never kill a good session again. Keeps a tiny, always-current ledger of the mission-critical context (rules, decisions + why, dead ends, next step) and re-injects it after /clear or compaction.

nudge_every.title: Checkpoint every N prompts
nudge_every.description: Remind Claude every N prompts to save new gems to the ledger. 0 turns checkpoints off.

warn_tokens.title: Sweep warning at (tokens)
warn_tokens.description: When the context reaches this many tokens, Claude does a full sweep and tells you it's safe to /clear. 0 turns the warning off.
